title: FrootAI Plugin Marketplace Registry
description: JSON Schema for the FrootAI plugin marketplace registry — the catalog of all plugins (themed bundles of agents, instructions, skills, and hooks) auto-generated by the FAI Factory on every merge to main. Frozen at v1.1 as part of Phase 0 (tracker item P0.2.004).

$schema.description: Optional schema URI for editor validation.

description.description: One-line description of what this marketplace catalogs.

version.description: Semantic version of the marketplace REGISTRY itself (not the schema). Increment on additive registry-level fields; reset plugin entries are unrelated.

generated.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this registry was generated by the FAI Factory.

plugins.description: Array of plugin entries. Each entry represents one themed bundle.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier (3–64 chars). Must match plugin.json `name` and the source folder name.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does.

author.description: Plugin author name. Use 'FAI Contributors' for community-maintained plugins.

source.description: Relative path to the plugin folder, starting with './'.

plays.description: Solution-play IDs this plugin is compatible with (NN-kebab-case).

items.description: Count of each primitive type bundled in the plugin. At least one count must be present.

verified.description: v1.1: Whether this publisher has completed identity verification. Reserved for Phase 5 publisher program. Defaults to false.

certified.description: v1.1: Whether FrootAI has performed a certification audit on this plugin. Reserved for Phase 5. Defaults to false.

deprecated.description: v1.1: Marks a plugin as deprecated. When true, MUST include `deprecationNotice`.

deprecationNotice.description: Required if `deprecated: true`. Explain why deprecated, suggested replacement, removal date.

replacedBy.description: Optional. If deprecated, the name of the plugin that replaces this one.
